We are seeking instructions on the settlement amount; the remaining placeholder is not a monetary offer. Please confirm whether these non-monetary terms are acceptable in principle.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute between them described as [INSERT AGREED DESCRIPTION OF DISPUTE, INCLUDING CASE CAPTION AND NUMBER IF APPLICABLE] (the “Dispute”), on the terms of this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff US$[AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Payment shall be made within ten business days after the later of (a) execution of this Agreement by both parties and (b) Defendant’s receipt of Plaintiff’s payment instructions, verified through a separately established contact channel. Defendant shall bear transfer charges necessary to ensure Plaintiff receives the full Settlement Amount.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute. Nothing in this Agreement releases, waives, or limits either party’s rights to enforce this Agreement.
